set.body:
There is currently no .Deprecated, .Defunct, or lifecycle badge anywhere on this
surface. The shorthands are marked legacy only by two bare source comments
(R/fmrilm.R:671, :674) that carry no runtime signal.

Add lifecycle::deprecate_warn() to: cor_struct, cor_iter, cor_global,
ar1_exact_first, ar_p, ar_voxelwise, robust_psi, robust_max_iter,
robust_scale_scope, robust, ar_options, robust_options, cfg, and the compute
formals (strategy, nchunks, use_fast_path, progress, parallel_voxels,
parallel_chunks).

Every deprecated argument needs a test asserting the warning fires once and the
translation produces the same config as the control= form.
set.title: Deprecate shorthands, options-list formals, and cfg= via lifecycle
